scope: fresh independent nominal simulation scenes after failed-state recovery training

task_observation: initial cup centre base XYZ plus destination cup centre base XYZ, in metres; simulator geometry in simulation; measured/localized centres required on real robot
test_source: fresh seeds not used for training or selection; aligned renderer, original state and action interface
baseline_comparison: v5/v6 can be compared on the old v6 diagnostic scenes; v7 transfer acceptance uses the new seeds
initialization: v7 epoch33, full 14-D normalization rebased with absolute physical outputs preserved
recovery_source_semantics: current cup centre relocalized once at new attempt start, then kept fixed; real localization adapter is required
